quote: Nevertheless, not to extinguish our free will, I hold it to be true that Fortune is the arbiter of one-half of our actions, but that she still leaves us to direct the other half, or perhaps a little less.
source: Niccolò Machiavelli, The Prince, chapter XXV (trans. W. K. Marriott, 1908)
